basic_details.job_title: MP Metro Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for General Manager, Deputy General Manager Posts

age_limit.age_details: Min: 55 years, Max: 63 years for Re-employment. Max: 57 years for GM/AGM, Max: 50 years for DGM.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B. Tech. in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics, Graduate
qualification.details: General Manager Qualifications: B.E./B. Tech. in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics from a Govt. recognized Institute/ University. Experience: Minimum 21 years post qualification experience in which 7 years' experience in relevant field/sub domain. Must be working in IDA pay scale of ₹120,000-2,80,000 OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above, or equivalent. For Re-employment: Minimum 21 years post qualification experience, retired from IDA pay scale of ₹120,000-280,000 or above OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above. Deputy General Manager Qualifications: Graduate from Govt Recognized University/ Institute. Experience: Minimum 9 years post qualification experience in which 5 years' experience in relevant field/sub domain. Must be working/worked in IDA pay scale of ₹70000-200000 OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-11 (7th CPC) or above, or equivalent. For Re-employment: Minimum 9 years post qualification experience, retired from IDA pay scale of 70000-200000 or above OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-11 (7th CPC) or above.

salary_details.details: General Manager: ₹120000-280000 (IDA) for Contract. Parent Pay plus Deputation Allowances & other applicable allowances OR Pay & allowances of MPMRCL as per rules of the corporation for Deputation. Consolidated Pay for retired officers joining on re-employment: ₹165900/- pm plus other applicable allowances. Additional General Manager: ₹100000-260000 for Contract. Parent Pay plus Deputation Allowances & other applicable allowances OR Pay & allowances of MPMRCL as per rules of the corporation for Deputation. Consolidated Pay for retired officers joining on re-employment: ₹142300/- pm or ₹127400/- pm plus other applicable allowances depending on previous pay scale. Deputy General Manager: ₹70000-200000 for Contract. Parent Pay plus Deputation Allowances & other applicable allowances OR Pay & allowances of MPMRCL as per rules of the corporation for Deputation. Consolidated Pay for retired officers joining on re-employment: ₹87800/- pm plus other applicable allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the MPMRCL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MPMRCL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the MPMRCL recruitment is 10 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPMRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of General Manager and Deputy General Manager in the MADHYA PRADESH METRO RAIL CORPORATION LIMITED (MPMRCL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the General Manager post?
faq.answer: For the General Manager post, candidates must possess a B.E./B. Tech. in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics from a Government-recognized Institute/University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Deputy General Manager post (Contract)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Deputy General Manager post when applying on a contract basis is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is ₹ 200 plus 18% GST. This fee needs to be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the General Manager post?
faq.answer: The salary for the General Manager post is in the IDA scale of ₹120000-280000 for contract positions. Other modes of employment have different pay structures.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification specifies recruitment in Madhya Pradesh, but it does not explicitly restrict applications from outside the state. However, candidates should check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the modes of application for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official website of MPMRCL or through www.mponline.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves an online application, followed by a screening process, an interview (which can be online or offline), and a medical examination.
